payload.summary: Planned an opt-in SIMPLIFY phase for autopilot between IMPL_REVIEW and VALIDATE, a read-only test_quality review finding type, and the spec amendment that turns 'manual invocation only' into 'not default-on'. Gate 1 selected Approach 1 (first-class phase plus additive enum); implementation is sequenced after fix-autopilot-archetype-and-apply-outcome archives.

decisions.title: SIMPLIFY is a first-class opt-in phase gated by one dynamic target on two edges
decisions.rationale: SIMPLIFY_OR_VALIDATE on IMPL_REVIEW converged and on IMPL_ITERATE complete under --no-review, resolved in transition() like VAL_REVIEW_OR_SUBMIT, so the flag cannot silently disappear in --no-review runs and the centralised-table test keeps holding.

decisions.title: SIMPLIFY is soft: refusals are `skipped`, and `skipped` resets the head to B1
decisions.rationale: Rule of 500, unpinnable surface, prune/contract/dual-run exit 2, and nothing-to-do all map to skipped -> VALIDATE. Dual-run failure never leaves a partial refactor for VALIDATE; only dispatch failure escalates.

decisions.title: Test-quality diagnostic is `type: test_quality` at criticality low, not a ninth axis
decisions.rationale: _is_blocking keys on criticality so low-criticality findings never block on their own; `type` is the precedented additive extension (behavioral_failure) while `axis` participates in consensus matching and would ripple through the synthesizer and both review skills.

decisions.title: Evidence counters define the exit criteria the 2026-08-04 manual-only decision lacked
decisions.rationale: lines_removed, files_touched, tests_pruned, seams_removed, dual_run_passed, skipped_reason on every SIMPLIFY outcome; dual_run_passed=false frequency is the number that keeps the phase opt-in.

decisions.title: Implement after fix-autopilot-archetype-and-apply-outcome archives
decisions.rationale: That change (54/59 tasks) is rewriting the same ~25 phase enumerations; adding SIMPLIFY once to the landed shape is one edit rather than a rebase across every table. Encoded as task 0.1.

decisions.title: Report and ledger are routed into the change directory by explicit paths
decisions.rationale: verify_behavior_preservation.py's CWD-relative default is right for manual use; the phase passes --report explicitly so VALIDATE and the PR can find evidence, and the portable script stays uncoupled from the OpenSpec layout.

next_steps: Task 0.1 first: confirm fix-autopilot-archetype-and-apply-outcome is archived and re-anchor Phase 1 against the landed TRANSITIONS/LoopState shape.
wp-review-diagnostic can start immediately in parallel; it has no dependency on the autopilot rewrite.
Follow-ups filed in design.md D9 (schema and spec phase-list drift) are deliberately not part of this change.
